Getting and setting subset data

getSubsetAssay()
Get subset assay from an ExperimentSubset object.
setSubsetAssay()
Method for storing new assays inside subsets in ExperimentSubset objects
getSubsetExperiment()
Take a subset out as a standalone experiment object
setSubsetExperiment()

Methods that take subsetName

Methods of Bioconductor generics that read or set a subset’s data when given subsetName, and otherwise act on the main object. Besides those below, these include assay(), assay<-, rowData(), colData(), reducedDim(), reducedDims(), altExp(), altExps(), altExpNames(), metadata() and their setters.

reducedDimNames<-
